newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE - Randfontein loss balloons in June qtr.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Randfontein loss balloons in June qtr.

text.p: Results for the quarter to end-June versus preceding quarter.
Net profit before capital spending 16.88 loss vs 2.86 loss
Full name: Randfontein Estates Gold Mining Co Witswatersrand Ltd, a unit of JCI Ltd
NOTE - The company said the mine's latest results already reflected the benefits of the retrenchment of 3,261 employees and a further restructuring programme.
Tonnage throughput in the various sections has been optimised such that recovered grades from underground will increase.
Working costs are expected to fall significantly following the completed retrenchment programme.
An increase in tonnage treated from surface sources at a section of the Doornkop plant will result in good profits.
The company said public holidays and the June 2 worker stay-away had a major effect on productivity in the quarter.
The mine's performance and the lower spot gold price had reduced the immediately available proven ore reserves to the extent that mining flexibility at high tonnage levels was severely hampered.
